objective: Evaluate the shared recipient execution loop and scene context against the full mission; preserve remaining acceptance gaps
comparison: Development: student acts with generic guidance and current observations
Teacher revises from compact actual student feedback
Student acts again from the same development initial condition
Freeze tools/guidance/memory; teacher-off parent and candidate on a separate layout/goal condition with equal per-arm budgets
If recording/physical checks permit, return to the original scene and verify no stale scene state is reused
cost_review: Inspect actual reported input/event counts after the first recipient run; do not continue expensive repeated calls without identifying whether the input budget can support the heldout comparison.
physical_rules: Every successful complete simulation receives the same frozen reference real counterpart or remains explicitly pending; failures do not require real replay
Read current RGB/joints before freezing the execution start; no blind restart of the old 15-trial batch
Only right-arm existing workspace/speed/gripper/slip controls; onsite plug reset and supported shutdown remain necessary
Unmatched actual layouts must be labelled unmatched, never a fair sim-real success comparison
New successful episode does not automatically imply training eligibility
not_claimed: No physical calibration or weak-model gain from code/fixture checks
No cross-task-family generalization without a separate task validation
